glyph_origin: The character's shape was historically very similar to 王; a dot was introduced to differentiate the two. Pictogram (象形): a picture of a cong (琮), a sort of ritual jade totem. It is also interpreted as three pieces of jade strung together on a string. It is also used as a simplification of 或.
senses: [yù] jade (originally nephrite, now also including jadeite)
